# Vocabulary reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py from tgo/ontology.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every node label and relationship type the pipeline may write. Edit the vocabulary in `tgo/ontology.py`,
then run `python scripts/gen_docs.py`. `tests/test_docs.py` fails if this page is stale.

Namespace: `tg:` = `https://{TGO_DOMAIN}/ontology/tg#`, instances `tgr:` = `https://{TGO_DOMAIN}/id/`
(`TGO_DOMAIN` defaults to `tgo.example.org`).

## Epistemic status

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `observed` | platform metadata, EXIF as read, OCR text as read |
| `file_declared` | XMP, docProps, ID3: forgeable by the file author |
| `inferred` | every ML output and every person link |
| `analyst` | human judgement or case grouping |

## Field visibility (`tg:FieldVisibility`)

`visible`, `hidden_by_privacy`, `not_set`, `not_requested`, `min_object`, `not_exposed_by_source`

## Visibility scope (`tg:visibilityScope`)

`public`, `members`, `admins`, `owner_only`, `link_holders`, `collector_only` (elevated sensitivity: `admins`, `owner_only`)

## Relationship types

Tiers: `structural` (container facts), `pairwise` (visible between two parties), `viewer_only`
(only the collector sees it), `admin_only` (only admins see it), `derived` (computed), `provenance`.

## Forbidden (the validator fails the graph if these appear)

Relations: `FACE_MATCH`, `OWL_SAMEAS`, `SAME_AS`, `SPEAKER_MATCH`, `STICKER_CREATOR_INFERRED`

Labels: `BiometricTemplate`, `FaceCluster`, `FaceEmbedding`, `SpeakerEmbedding`, `VoicePrint`

## Concept schemes

- **Group roles:** `creator`, `owner`, `admin`, `member`, `restricted`, `banned`, `left`, `subscriber`, `booster`, `giveaway_winner`, `call_participant`, `speaker`, `inviter`, `approver`, `originator`, `amplifier`, `bridge`, `hub`, `core`, `peripheral`
- **Group kinds:** `private_chat`, `basic_group`, `supergroup`, `gigagroup`, `forum`, `broadcast_channel`, `monoforum`, `forum_topic`, `community`, `chatlist`, `group_call`, `giveaway`, `boosters`
- **Algorithms:** `leiden_cpm`, `leiden_modularity`, `louvain`, `infomap`, `kcore`, `coortweet`, `nomenklatura_xref`, `splink`, `noisy_or_evidence`
- **Judgements:** `positive`, `negative`, `unsure`, `no_judgement`
- **Special-category chat topics (GDPR Art. 9):** `ethnicity`, `health`, `politics`, `religion`, `sexuality`, `trade_union`

## Not obtainable from Telegram (shown as typed gaps)

| Fact | Why |
|---|---|
| Original uploaded bytes of a compressed photo | API exposes only server-resized renditions |
| Reliable EXIF/GPS/C2PA from photo-mode images | re-encoded JPEGs; survives only on documents |
| Transcripts/waveforms via Bot API or Desktop export | only MTProto messages.transcribeAudio |
| Channel subscriber lists, boosters, join requesters, story viewers | admin/owner only |
| Member lists via the Bot API | bots cannot enumerate members |
| Other users' privacy rules | only the collector's own account.getPrivacy |
| A verified sticker-set creator from the set ID | unofficial, untested, excluded by design |
| Message-media IDs in the Desktop export | join by (chat, msg, date) or sha256 |
| People Nearby geo-groups | feature retired September 2024 |
